experiment_data.hypothesis: A config-level signal router (RF/LR) can predict the optimal construction signal per config from features (degeneracy_rate, base_f1, oracle_headroom), outperforming always-LP baseline. Router ΔF1 should exceed always-LP ΔF1.
experiment_data.notes: E1 signal routing. RF 56.2% LOO accuracy (below 60% target) but router ΔF1 +0.39pp > always-LP +0.15pp (2.6× improvement, target met). Low accuracy due to small n=16 and class imbalance. D176: appendix-only, not main claim.
